actions.name: play_word
actions.description: Play one word card from state.hand onto the current tile. Clearing a tile needs state.tiles[position].needed words. If the word is secretly mined and the mine is armed, it detonates: -22 fuse and the trapper gets paid. Costs 5 fuse.

actions.name: buy_hint
actions.description: Pay $0.001 USDC via x402 to score every word in state.hand for mine risk (0..1). Scores appear in state.hint. Costs 3 fuse.

actions.name: challenge_word
actions.description: Type (not play) one word you suspect is mined. Disarms any mine already armed on that word. A mine planted after your challenge can still arm on a later turn - a challenged word is safer, never guaranteed. Costs 8 fuse.

actions.name: defuse_tile
actions.description: Skip the current tile without playing any word. Costs 20 fuse. Only state.defusesLeft uses remain.
